layout.title: Access control
layout.subtitle: Roles, assignments, mask functions, and Cedar policy authoring.

roles.blurb: Roles are the unit policies and JIT grants attach to.
roles.emptyHint: Add a role to start authoring policy.
roles.deleteConsequence: Policies and assignments referencing it may be removed by the server.

assignments.blurb: Map a principal to a base role. IdP groups resolve server-side; this is the explicit override.
assignments.emptyHint: Assign a role to a principal to grant it.

maskFns.blurb: Deterministic transforms column policies apply when action is MASK.
maskFns.emptyHint: Add one to reference from column policies.
maskFns.deleteConsequence: Column policies referencing it will lose their transform.

cedarPolicies.blurb: Cedar policy source, evaluated by the authz decision service: admin.* / task.* / grant.revoke, result.read.unmasked / result.read.masked (per column), datasource.connect / sql.* (per statement). Full reference in the editor below.
cedarPolicies.emptyHint: Author a policy to grant or restrict any authz action — admin, approval, column read, or per-statement datasource access.
cedarPolicies.systemManagedHint: Shipped system policy ({key}) — managed by migration. Only enable/disable is editable.
cedarPolicies.deleteConsequence: Any admin.*/task.*/grant.revoke decision that relied on this rule re-evaluates without it.
cedarPolicies.sourceHint: Cedar syntax highlighting and keyword completion. Validate checks parse/schema errors without saving.

actionNotes.adminPolicies: manage Cedar policies, roles, mask fns
actionNotes.taskRequest: create a task on a datasource
actionNotes.taskRead: read task or grant metadata only
actionNotes.taskAssume: assume the task's execution role to read saved result data
actionNotes.resultReadMasked: masked (column's mask fn, or a safe default)
actionNotes.datasourceConnect: may touch this datasource at all
actionNotes.sqlInsert: run INSERT (also required for an upsert)
actionNotes.sqlUpdate: run UPDATE (also required for an upsert)
